description.en: The application ID. To get this ID, call the [ListApplication](~~149390~~) operation.

description.zh: 配置自定义弹性行为，具体数据结构参考样例。
description.en: The configuration for custom scaling behaviors. For more information about the data structure, see the example.

description.zh:
是否启用弹性伸缩策略。

- **true**：启用规则。

- **false**：禁用规则。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the Auto Scaling rule.

- **true**: enables the rule.

- **false**: disables the rule.

description.zh: 弹性伸缩策略的名称。支持以小写字母开头，允许小写字母、数字、中划线（-）组成，长度为1~32字符的字符串。
description.en: The name of the Auto Scaling rule. The name must start with a lowercase letter. It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 32 characters long.

description.zh: 触发器策略。设置为ScalingRuleTriggerDTO的JSON格式，具体样式，请参见请求参数补充说明。
description.en: The trigger policy. Set this parameter to a JSON string of the ScalingRuleTriggerDTO object. For more information about the format, see Additional information about request parameters.

description.zh: 弹性伸缩策略类型，仅支持**trigger**类型。
description.en: The type of the Auto Scaling rule. Only the **trigger** type is supported.

title.zh: 创建应用弹性伸缩规则

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas create-application-scaling-rule --app-id 78194c76-3dca-418e-a263-cccd1ab40000 --scaling-rule-name cpu-trigger --scaling-rule-type trigger --scaling-rule-enable true --scaling-rule-metric 1 --scaling-rule-timer 1 --scaling-rule-trigger ScalingRuleTriggerDTO_...... --scaling-behaviour scaleUp_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_0_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Pods_,_value_:_5,_periodSeconds_:_15_,_scaleDown_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_300_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Percent_,_value_:_200,_periodSeconds_:_15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas POST /pop/v1/eam/scale/application_scaling_rule --region cn-hangzhou --ScalingRuleMetric 1 --ScalingRuleTimer 1 --ScalingRuleTrigger 'ScalingRuleTriggerDTO_......' --ScalingRuleName 'cpu-trigger' --AppId '78194c76-3dca-418e-a263-cccd1ab40000' --ScalingRuleEnable true --ScalingBehaviour 'scaleUp_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_0_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Pods_,_value_:_5,_periodSeconds_:_15_,_scaleDown_:_stabilizationWindowSeconds_:_300_,_selectPolicy_:_Max_,_policies_:_type_:_Percent_,_value_:_200,_periodSeconds_:_15' --ScalingRuleType trigger --header "Content-Type=application/json"
